academic.passage: The theory of relativity fundamentally changed our understanding of space and time. Proposed by Albert Einstein in the early 20th century, it consists of two main components: special relativity and general relativity. Special relativity introduced the concept that the laws of physics are the same for all observers, regardless of their relative motion. This led to the famous equation E=mc², highlighting the equivalence of mass and energy. General relativity, on the other hand, extends the principle to include gravitational effects, describing gravity as the curvature of space-time caused by mass. Together, these theories not only revolutionized physics but also had profound implications for our understanding of the universe, influencing areas such as cosmology and astrophysics.

questions.q: What inference can be made about general relativity?
options: It is simpler than special relativity.
It extends the principles of special relativity.
It was proposed after special relativity.

questions.explain: 在這段文字中，質量指的是物體中的物質。
